page.overview:
Who is Aramond Tuestrel?

was the Grand-Conservator of the city of Molaesmyr, who spearheaded the investigation into the crystal well that was the natural magic fount of power upon which the city was founded. He theorized the well was a gift from the Arch Heart that was lost in the Calamity and rediscovered when the city was founded within the Veluthil Forest. Others (including Ezradan), however, believed the well to be arcane in nature, and most probably fallen from one of the ancient floating cities, such as Aeor.

Aramond and the other researchers were delving deeper and deeper into the caverns below their city, hoping to learn the nature of the well's power, when the corrupting, toxic miasma that eventually destroyed the city and the entire surrounding Veluthil Forest was unleashed while Ruidus was ascendant during an Apogee Solstice.
